title: Micro Assistant
description: Shows which counting relics and powers each card play affects - on the hovered card, and above the End Turn button.
changeNote: v0.19.0: Block-on-play powers are now tracked. Child of the Stars, Pillar of Creation, Afterimage, Rage, Danse Macabre, Spirit of Ash, and Shroud badge the cards that would trigger them with the Block that play brings, and Feel No Pain's badge now shows the total Block for that card. The pending-Block shield beside your Block now previews the card you are hovering: it adds the Block that playing it sets off (including Ornamental Fan, Tuning Fork, Permafrost, and Intimidating Helmet) and drops Orichalcum or Ripple Basin if the card would cancel them. Feel No Pain's Block from Ethereal cards exhausting at turn end is included too. The options menu now ends with a byline.
